english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(3) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) Options (M) to (O) include any indecent or obscene article of any kind whether or not they are similar to those mentioned in Para 85(3)(a).
(ii) Section 85(3) distinguishes between records of items which are reflected in offence wording H3813 and items per se reflected in this heading. (iii) Childlike sex dolls - whilst there is no specific offence of simply possessing a childlike sex doll there are some potential connected offences. This is one of the possible offences and CPS have provided some useful Legal Guidance which provides the details.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
